criterion: A published app opens at one stable address, and promoting a new version serves the new release at that same address.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the address of the published app is unchanged after a promotion and the link opens the app. Answer no when the address changes on promotion or the link stops opening the app.

criterion: The workspace home shows only the apps the signed-in member's group grants, so a support member sees a single app card.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the app card grid holds only apps the member's group grants. Answer no when a card for an ungranted app appears.

criterion: The site header carries a demo booking control rendered as the quieter dark control and a free start rendered as the loud pale one.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the demo control is the quieter of the pair and the free start is the louder. Answer no when the two are reversed or rendered alike.

criterion: The footer closes every public page with the product wordmark set large enough to span most of the width of the screen.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the wordmark is the last element of the footer and spans most of the width. Answer no when the wordmark is small or absent from the footer.

criterion: An empty data grid and a refused data grid render as two visibly different states, one naming what would appear there and one naming the refusal.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the two states carry different wording and different treatment. Answer no when an empty grid and a refused grid render alike.

criterion: The editor shows a component tree, a canvas, a query panel and an inspector, with draggable dividers between the four regions.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when all four regions render and a divider can be dragged. Answer no when a region is missing or the dividers are fixed.

criterion: The console search control displays its keyboard shortcut on the control itself.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the shortcut hint renders on or beside the search control. Answer no when the shortcut is undiscoverable from the interface.

criterion: The resource form shows a set indicator and a replace action in place of a stored secret.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the credential field renders as a set indicator with a replace action. Answer no when a masked value is rendered that a client control could reveal.

criterion: Signing in after a redirect from a console address returns the member to the address originally requested.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the member lands on the remembered console address after signing in. Answer no when the member lands anywhere else.

criterion: The demo request form keeps every typed value on screen when the submission comes back as a failure.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the typed work email is still in the field after a failed submission. Answer no when the field is cleared.

criterion: Every public route renders on one near-black field with warm off-white type, and a light rendering of a public route is absent from the build.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when every public route renders dark with warm off-white type. Answer no when any public route renders on a light field.

criterion: Icons across the public surface are drawn from unit squares on a coarse integer grid rather than from smooth curves.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the caret, the action arrow and the ornament read as square-grid drawings. Answer no when the icon set reads as a conventional curved library.

criterion: A light travels around the border of the prompt composer at a pace slow enough that the movement is hard to catch.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a travelling light follows the composer border slowly. Answer no when the border is static or the movement reads as a fast animation.

criterion: A text link on the home route retracts its underline toward the trailing edge and grows a fresh underline from the leading edge when hovered.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the underline retracts one way and re-emerges from the other side. Answer no when the underline slides across or simply fades.

criterion: Controls on the sign-in route and on the workspace home show a visible focus ring when reached by keyboard.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when tabbing through a console screen shows a visible ring on each control. Answer no when focus is invisible on any control.

criterion: Body text and interface controls meet the AA contrast ratio in both console themes.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when sampled body text and controls clear the AA ratio in the dark theme and in the light theme. Answer no when either theme falls below.

criterion: At phone width the marketing header shrinks as one piece and keeps the proportions of the desktop header.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the phone header is a proportionally scaled copy of the desktop header. Answer no when the phone header is re-typeset at different proportions.

criterion: At a narrow phone width the editor states that authoring needs a larger display and offers the app preview instead.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a narrow phone window shows that message and a working preview. Answer no when the editor attempts a cramped four-region layout.

criterion: A masked customer name reaches a restricted member unmasked somewhere in the product.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the masked value is readable by a restricted member anywhere in the product. Answer no when the masked value is absent everywhere a restricted member can look.

criterion: An empty data grid and a grid the member may see nothing of render identically, so absence and denial read the same.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the two states are indistinguishable on screen. Answer no when each state carries its own wording and treatment.
